root_cause: Inconsistent/incomplete arithmetic when converting an array-element-count-based allocation macro (FT_QNEW_ARRAY, which handles sizeof internally) into a manual pool-size computation; the sizeof multiplier for one of five sub-buffers (peak_coords, an FT_Fixed array) was dropped while it was correctly applied to the other four, so the pool undersizes the first field by a factor of sizeof(FT_Fixed).
findings: In TT_Vary_Apply_Glyph_Deltas(), the refactor to a single shared allocation pool computes peak_coords_size as ALIGN_SIZE(3 * blend->num_axis) — the number of FT_Fixed elements needed — but omits the `* sizeof (FT_Fixed)` factor that every other sub-buffer in the same pool_size computation includes (point_deltas_x_size, points_org_size, points_out_size, has_delta_size all multiply by the element si
